items.summary: Matthias Dolderer joined the Red Bull Air Race in 2008 and spent years building experience, reaching the podium several times by 2015. After that season ended without a title, he took a hard look at his approach. He broke down every part of his process, including his airplane, his team, his communication, and his overall infrastructure, and rebuilt it around one clear goal. In 2016 he became World Champion. Watch this episode of Between Two Wings to hear Dolderer's full story, from his first flight in 2009 to becoming a world champion: https://lnkd.in/ecrbn3fT #JeppesenForeFlight #AviationPodc

items.summary: Weather shifts, a GNSS interference warning pops up, turnaround times change, and the cockpit and the OCC often end up working from a different version of the same flight, with crew piecing together several tools to keep up. AvioBook's solution package Enhanced Awareness closes that gap. Weather, in-flight threats, turnaround data, and airport information come together in one consistent picture, shared identically by cockpit and OCC. 🌍 Globe: a live map that keeps weather, turbulence, and GNSS interference visible right where the crew is already looking. ⏰ CDM (Collaborative Decision Making):

items.summary: There's a lot of data sitting on every aircraft after a flight. To analyze incidents, improve efficiency, or troubleshoot a defect, airlines need it, straight from the source. For most fleets, that still means sending someone out to retrieve it in person. AvioCast removes that step.
